Commemorative notices for the month of Maskaram

Introduction for Maskaram

In the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, one God. With the help of the Lord and his gracious gift, we begin writing the book of the Synaxarion, which means “assembly,” which our holy fathers, the teachers of the Church, copied.
The honored father Abba Michael, bishop of the cities of Athribis and Melig, and the honored father Abba John, bishop of the city of Burullus.
And other holy and honored fathers, who compiled this book from all the accounts of the acts of angels, apostles, prophets, martyrs, archbishops, righteous people, hermits, and monks.
So that their commemorations might be celebrated and the accounts of their struggles read every day, from the first of Maskaram to the end of the year.
It was compiled in the year 963 of the pure martyrs. May their prayers and blessings be with us. Amen.
